description: email.rs:725-728 doc comment: 'Assigns a blobId equal to the email's id (a MemoryBackend convention)'. This is wrong on two counts: (1) the function assigns Id::from('placeholder-blob'), not the email's id; and (2) 'MemoryBackend convention' references a specific test backend in a library doc comment. A contributor reading this function would be confused about what blobId they will get and why the MemoryBackend matters here. The comment should explain what the handler actually does: blobId is set to a placeholder because RFC 8621 §5.5 says blobId is server-set; the backend replaces it in create_object.
title: build_email_from_create doc leaks MemoryBackend convention into library doc
